ONE-FORMAT OF30 cut B: population.product-creatures leaves the client plan with engine cut B, which already refuses it at runtime. The kept-originals corpus is the contract (FE3/FE5) and carries none of it; no current engine pin does either. 15 unpinned Driftwood r2 builds in the pin cache carry it (J486 prune candidates, not kept originals); one of them, 329f37d67d676ad001e2b39fad443ce84f9708cb14e062e67a5fede2ba34a3fb, validates on 0.71.0 and is refused after this. Coordinator's call 2026-11-23: no version bump
